articles.summary: Accomplished insurance executive brings leadership in specialty insurance and finance WILMINGTON, Del., Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Global Indemnity Group, LLC (NASDAQ:GBLI) (“GBLI”) today announced the appointment of Jessica Buss to its Board of Directors, effective October 26, 2026, succeeding Bruce Lederman who retired from the Board. “Jessica builds insurance businesses,” said Saul Fox, founder and Chairman of GBLI and founder and CEO of Fox Paine Company, whose affiliate is GBLI’s largest shareholder. “She brings deep expertise in underwriting and excess and surplus lines, along with significant distribution relationships across the market. GBLI has a longstanding history of profitable growth as a ‘Main Street’ specialty and surplus lines insurer, and we are rolling out our Kaleidoscope technology platform and other new initiatives. We are delighted to welcome Jessica to the Board to help us build on that foundation.” Ms. Buss is a veteran insurance industry executive
articles.title: Global Indemnity Group, LLC Appoints Jessica Buss to its Board of Directors

articles.summary: WILMINGTON, Del., Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Global Indemnity Group, LLC (NASDAQ:GBLI) (“GBLI”) announced today that it will release its third quarter 2026 earnings results before market open on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. GBLI will hold an earnings call to discuss third quarter 2026 results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern. The earnings call will be webcast on GBLI’s website at www.gbli.com . Investors and analysts interested in asking representatives of GBLI’s management questions regarding third quarter 2026 results may do so by dialing +1 (800) 715-9871 and using Conference ID 9023718 or by submitting written questions through the webcast.
